subject: CYCLE-2 HANDOFF — P0 Lane C same-attempt first-useful presentation gate
body: Executable Android-free gate passed 16/16 deterministic/adversarial tests plus 100,000 randomized churn/proof sequences. Successful bridge release requires a matching current proof tuple (service_epoch, attempt_id, route_generation, display_id, foreground_token) plus native-target eligibility and trusted native-present metadata. ROUTE_READY, panel power, OPEN_INNER, cover-host loss, stale route/foreground receipts, and pre-crash receipts cannot success-release. Cover-host loss => TRANSFER_REQUIRED; route remap/foreground switch invalidate evidence; service restart increments/fences service_epoch; timeout => DEGRADED_TIMEOUT_RELEASE (not success); reversal => ABORTED; FIRST_INTERACTIVE remains later/separate. Recommend implementing this contract and physically validating on Fold7 before promotion.
